name: Coffee Cup
description: A coffee cup with liquid that sloshes in gentle waves while loading

variations.name: default
variations.description: An outlined coffee cup where two layered waves of liquid slosh continuously at a constant level

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the front liquid wave

props.name: secondaryColor
props.description: Color of the lighter back wave

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Color of the cup outline, handle and saucer

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Fill color of the cup interior

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
